note: Reviewer names omitted. Order is the Play page default, not by date. Not a complete set. In this sample 380 of 540 reviews are 1 or 2 stars (70%); the shown order is the page's default, so these counts are not the app's overall rating.

reviews.text: As a paid, premium "Withings +" customer I am literally unable to use this terrible app. Step 1, open the app and wait with a blank screen for about two minutes while it syncs ? (if it doesn't force close). Step 2, navigate to an area of interest and then wait another two minutes for the app to respond. Step 3, wonder why im paying for this especially when I was duped into the BeamO which is a 250 dollar thermometer as everything else is restricted in the US (should have never been released)

If it stayed working properly, it would be awesome. But it somehow seems to kick out my member info, which then doesn't connect the info to the app, so I have to manually add my weigh-in's, etc. If not for the charts to actually see the results that I manually input, I'd probably just manually track in a notebook or something. But if the scale kept my info, especially since I'm the only one in my house that uses it, it would be a pretty amazing system!

Most functions work fine. Some of the important ones are sporadic or don't give results at all. For instance, ECG and sp02 functions give conclusive data about half the time while segmental body composition doesn't work at all. For $600 + $10 a month... Very disappointed. I can get these kind of results for much less in this market. Most likely returning.

the app regularly provides incomplete or inaccurate data when imported from health connect. for example I have notice that my sleep was "not very much!" when it showed 8 hours and 21 min. This failure to read the data then flows through the whole app so any scores that rely on sleep are also garbage. You can't remove any of this junk data from the screen, only the focus area. But of course the AI just keeps giving direction to buttons that don't exist. The parts of the app that do work are slow

I have enjoyed using my scale with this app for a couple years now. Mostly, it has been a good experience. But recently, I'm having a terrible time connecting and getting the weight data to download into my phone. Help pages aren't detailed enough to help me identify and fix the issue, and I can't figure out how to reach customer service. The low rating is for ineffective customer service

It worked fine until I had to change phones. Now there's no way to recover the account, no way to calibrate the watch and no way to contact these chuckleheads directly. Their support center is useless. This much security for a watch is ridiculous. I will be deleting the app and getting a different watch. Something a little more user friendly instead of this $250 paperweight.

Far too complicated of an app, if you want to just track your weight! My Dad is in his eighties, and we kids just want to be able to remotely see and record his weight over time, to report to his doctor. I can't get this scale to recognize my dad and save his weight from one day to the next, even though he's the only one using it. I have to manually associate the unassigned weights after I've tracked them down in the too complicated app.

I don't love the layout because there's no good way to look at all of the data from a given day in one spot unless it's today. You can see past data by opening a specific area of the app, but then can't compare it to other types of data from the same day easily. Lastly, I bought a $400 watch, why do I have to pay $100 a year for a health report? Overall, nothing is an improvement and some things are a step backwards from what their competitors had 6 years ago. Now no informational pages load.

Confusing screens and information. when looking for help, it appears that information is out of date and is not in sync with the app, making it very difficult to troubleshoot issues or settings. if you set a graph to semester versus week, you will see different weight gain percentages but on the main screen, it does not acknowledge that you have a different period set. i feel like this app tries to do too much. It's not fully thought out. i will not buy another product from them.

Overall, the app is quite well designed and data visualisations are easy to understand. However, there are several bugs and no way to report them. After a recent update, all my temperature measurements (synchronised from Fitbit) were deleted. The app shows my vascular age while also saying it doesn't have enough data to show the measurement. An adaptive themed icon should also be added.

Helped me install the app in a tedious process, great, logged my weight one time and now....how do I log my weight automatically? There are ZERO instructions on how to do that, turning on Bluetooth doesn't do anything, and nothing pops up when I open the app. It's a glorified weight loss scale with a useless app, but at least it was free.

the actual blood pressure monitor works well and connects to the app smoothly most of the time. The app itself is annoying for me. I just want to click a button and check my blood pressure but, instead, I have to first click the device icon, then scroll down through various friendly "Get to know your device"(had it for 7 years!) nonsense. The actual 'Take a Measurement' button is easy to scroll past and miss. The graphs and info are helpful.

Constantly crashes, if you try to refresh to get the latest data it stays refreshing forever, no good diagnostic why your data isn't updating even though you check the device, check/open the scale, crash, open the app for too long, crash, click on something and then something else too quickly, crash. I don't think this app is getting updated anymore and this should caution people on purchasing their hardware if that's the case. Phone S25 Ultra

The app will not connect to my Withings Body Pro2 scales. It used to give an error now it can't even find it. The scales will now say it's all set up and it's working but it's still not connected to the app. If the app is not going to work with the scales then they can go back they are of no use to me if the app is not going to work. even after 6/12/26 update. scales are useless without a functioning app.

the app keeps crashing. I have been unable to open it since Feb 2026. I have deleted and installed this app like 10+ time now. no change. customer service too as they don't really help. keep asking me to delete and re-install. when the app does open, it gives me a blank screen. the charge sucks too. I have to figet with it multiple times to get the watch to sit juat right so that it will charge. right now wondering what happened to its quality. it has gone down since it was bought by Nokia.

it mostly works as a logger. i am a very active however the dashboard is full of warning icons that im unhealthy because my bmi is too high (i have a lot of muscle which it knows) and my systolic is low (because i exercise which it knows). i just want an option to shut that stuff off. my doctor is cool with it, this app needs to chill out. the blood pressure monitor itsel takes a lot of effort to get an accurate reading (the omron is not nearly so sensitive to placement or seating position).
1 person found this review helpful

Neat insights and all, but I can't for the life of me get it to auto connect with my watch when I start a workout on the watch. I have to literally open the app, go to the watch device page and let it sit for like a minute before it finally wakes up and starts the gps enabled workout on the phone 😒. Even outside of workouts sometimes it'll go 2 entire days without syncing. very annoying.
1 person found this review helpful

scale seems accurate but the app leaves so much to be desired. for example, it doesn't even tell you total weight loss. Anywhere. It just displays an 'average' no matter where you look. The fact that I need to use a calculator to know how much I have actually lost instead of from an app that literally revolves around a scale is laughable. luckily, I got the scale for free from my doctor.

The app used to work Oct. and part of Nov. Since then it constantly crashes. I have to open it numerous times for it to appear in my notifications to monitor my heart rate, which is the reason I went with this brand. its beyond frustrating. edit to add... it is now Jan. 17th and it still crashes constantly. It closes so it doesnt connect. PLEASE FIX IT. I came back to say its junk. About 6 months old and now my watch will not charge at all. beyond frustrating!!

The health features for my device work pretty well, the app has a few issues: Notification vibratio and sound go off we very 5-10 seconds when using the application, more often when my watch connects (every time any data seems to transfer or connection is made) My watch takes several minutes to connect to the app and at times, is hard to connect. Push notifications don't seem to work on my devices ce. I am running an Android ROG phone 7 CN model that is up to date, with app up to date.

Using the app for years. The last update was horrible. Same as other users, please revert it back. The UI seems to have gone backward in terms of usability. I now can't figure out how much I changed in the period I want to select. I can only see the trendline for static period, which is useless. Trendline used to be alongside actual data. Please go back to the old screen, or I will have to look for a new product (including scales that are only accurate occasionally anyway).

I have been using this app for years, and have enjoyed the tracking and features it offers. Specifically the freedom to view the graph as I want, scrolling through time or zooming in on specific data points. Unfortunately that has been removed in the most recent update and the graphs are no longer as useful. Being locked into specific time frames (week, month, day, year, all) is a step back.

New weight history display is way worse. You can't just drag to zoom in and zoom out like you did before. You need to tap on each dot to zoom in one level at a time, so it takes forever to compare where you are vs the year. Individual data points are also completely hidden now, so you only see a single average number, so it's impossible now to tell how much you're fluctuating, or if you had big spikes up or down. Overall, this app just keeps on getting worse every year.

Can't customize app. Weird. It's a scale app but the weight is three tiles down from the top on the home screen. The actual weight is lost in a clutter of "body comp" info that is not the straight-up weight. The most irritating thing for me is that I have to do math to calculate the change from last weigh-in. The scale will show it if you happen to look down at the right time, but I can't find it on the app. Finally, the scale shows the weather and air quality. What!?! The scale is customizable.

Works okay, but the in app analysis is not as good as other apps I've seen. For example, the "average trend" of weight over a time period is the first point in the period minus the last. That's not a trend, that's a difference. How about you add some statistical analysis and fit a line to average out the noise? That's just one example. There are many more opportunities within the dashboards.
1 person found this review helpful

Update: The update made the data viewer better, but the old one is still superior. The most annoying of which is the new viewer still remains oddly locked to certain time steps, I can't zoom in and out at will. --- Used to be excellent, but the most recent update made it substantially worse though still not terrible. Can no longer arbitrarily zoom in and out on graphs, you are locked into certain time frames (week, month, year).

I have the Body Smart scale (I don't recommend it). The app works. But it's not useful. There aren't any helpful insights into the data recorded. The "gaining weight" trend text when I gain 0.5lbs is really terrible. I've stopped opening the app because it's just a negative experience. Plus, the body composition doesn't work. It's never changed and is a ridiculous reading. If there were more information about these readings then maybe it would make sense.

I love the watch and used to love the app. A few months back though, the app updated and now to get GPS tracking you have to trigger the workout from your watch and then open the app on your phone, otherwise it won't record your GPS track. That's a huge pain when you're trying to run. I'm told downgrading to the old version of the app fixes the problem, so Withings' answer of "oh this is a problem with Android" is likely a cop-out, which is disappointing.

Will only randomly sync. I constantly have to uninstall & reinstall the app and reset the scale to get data to sync. This is beyond frustrating. 30-45 minutes every other day to retrieve data from the scale. This seems to be a known and yet unresolved issue. You'd be better off just buying a scale from a different company. It's useless If you want to do anything beyond temporarily seeing your weight.

Scale is completely inaccurate. Says I weigh between 238-254 (my real weight is around 135). Set up failed repeatedly. Spent 5 hours trying to set up. It is now back in the box. Troubleshooting page is zero help. Location enabled for device, won't stay connected to phone. Updated, reset and still nothing but inaccurate readings, arrows won't go away no matter how much I adjust weight balance. Overall fail and I would never recommend.

Update: manual entries, despite putting in the correct date default to the previous day. 5 years later it still won't sync to my fitbit, and if my scale synched to anything else I wouldn't bother with this app. Update: for the response, which failed to address what i said and shows the response lacks basic comprehension skills, the issue is with the app, i cannot enter the correct data, so the web dash will only show what I've entered. Uninstall/reinstall doesn't help either.

I have the ScanWatch 2 & the app just told me that I burned 8500 calories yesterday which is incorrect. The step count was way off too. I tried resyncing to see if it would fix that but no luck. There's no option to delete incorrect info. It doesn't record/autodetect physical activity, like dancing. It doesn't record sleeping right either. I wanted to see if the snoring feature worked & it doesn't. It just tells me had a few interruptions in my sleep but didn't tell me why. So disappointed.

The software has become almost unusable. It's very difficult to find the data. It uploads data to the wrong profile and there doesn't appear to be any way to fix it. Maybe there is but it's well hidden. Constant badgering to subscribe to other services and big portions of the UI taken up for ads for other services. My profile has disappeared from the scale even though it's still in the app and everything gets sent to my wife's profile. Have tried factory resetting and reinstalling.
1 person found this review helpful

App used to be great, but they keep breaking basic features. If you have multiple people, it always assigns all the weights to the primary user. It used to figure out who it was based on their weight history. And if it was wrong, you used to be able to edit them in the app to fix things. Now, you just have to delete the errant entries and lose all the data. There's no way to email support. I don't have time to sit around and wait for chat support.

Overall, I like the app. I use it to monitor my sleep. About a year ago, the dates got messed up and I haven't been able to fix it. It's a day ahead. So, "Sunday" data is actually for Saturday. I uninstalled the app and tried to resign up, but when I put in my birthday, the same thing happened. it listed my birthday on May 19, even though I typed in May 20. When I clicked to edit, it shows May 20. Very odd.

It's pretty simple, the app will not install on my pixel phone. It variously gets anywhere from 25 to 75% installed and then it just runs and runs and runs until it times out with an error. I've been trying for months now cuz I have a Withings Smart scale that I've had for years, but when I last updated my phone and had to do a full reset and re-enter of my apps it simply hasn't been able to install.

Overall the app is pretty good with keeping track of your weight. I've been using my Withings scale for about 4 years now. However, lately the app has been having issues shutting down and closing as soon as I open it. Also, I have to manually pair my scale every time I want it to sync which has been annoying. My phone and my scale are on the same Internet and connected to Bluetooth. But for some reason the scale is unable to send information to my phone unless I manually sync them.

I loved this app, but it has stopped activating GPS tracking when starting a workout from the watch. I have to constantly open the app to activate tracking. Also, the sleep data integration is pretty poor with Google Fit via Health Connect. Overall, the app is nowhere near as good as it used to be so I downgraded to a previous version and now it works perfectly fine. If you're using a scan watch v. 1, don't jump on updates early until the Withings team figures out these issues.

Please bring back the old graphing functionally. I have almost 10 years of weight data associated to my account, and now I don't have the same level insight into any of it. I loved how it was previously displayed and would go into the app regularly. Now I don't really see a need to use the app. I'm going to have to go old school and move everything back to an Excel spreadsheet in order to do any of the analysis that was previously available.

Used to be great, but not anymore. Since the update, it hardly ever syncs without resetting and messing with it. When it does sync, the data is innacurate (will show the wrong month for the data taken) - and on top of that the user interface is horrible now. How can I go back to before the update when it worked right??? Notice how everyone is saying the same thing in recent reviews and Withings hasn't fixed it? Users are super frustrated! It's too expensive to keep trying to diagnose it!!

Doesn't work well with other apps and tracking devices. There are limited apps it supposedly works with. Help to resolve issues is a puzzle. Not good for a paid subscription. (updated) Followed the link explained my issues on the form which was clunky and required the serial number of the scale and it been a week with no response. The subscription is 99 dollars and this is the service? regreting my purchase of the scale and the subscription

I can tell this is a good app. However, I'm having an issue with the app doubling (or more) my step count. As much as id love to do 30,000+ steps in one day, that's not the regular whatsoever 😂. I can assure you I've tried everything... spent an hour and a half troubleshooting everything but re-downloading the app because I don't want to lose my stats. Posting this to hopefully resolve, and post for any others that are having the same issue. I have a Samsung Galaxy S21 5G.

The app doesn't work very well. I weigh every day and sometimes the scale's info shows up on the app and sometimes it doesn't. Most of the time it doesn't. The scale doesn't register properly either. When it reports BMI after the weight and then the weather temps for the day, it is working properly. That doesn't happen too often. Not impressed with the scale or the app.

There's no button in the app to force the device to synchronize. Often the scale will not send its measurements to the app. App doesn't have great support for viewing your data at selected time frames. E.g. on January 7th there's no way to compare to data from the last few months outside of looking at your data for all time. The graphs are set by Day, Week, Month, Year, or All. Outside of that, decent data collection and interaction with smart health devices.

As far as the scale goes I have compared against 2 others and my weight was the same on all 3, so it seems to be accurate in weight. I have no way of testing the accuracy of all the other metrics it measures but they all seem to follow my weight loss pattern accurately. The app is awesome, have had zero issues with it crashing or not working. No ads and I love being able to keep track of my progress and look at it from year, month and week. Very motivating!

I am a new user and must say this app is not good at all. Aweful is the word that comes to mind. It is nothing more than a repository of the data coming from the weight scale. And even that has something to be desired. It doesn't link to Fitbit, one of the reasons I went with Withings in the first place. I really expected more from Withings especially at this price point.

This device has repeatedly not recognized me. It is extremely frustrating to buy a product that when it works right(not very often), it's great. After considering the hours I've wasted, and that now I can't even link them up after I've had to continue resetting over and over again, I would use it as a doorstop if it wasn't so big. I will make one final attempt to reach out to customer frustration 🫤 🤔🤐

Will not connect scale, the help articles do not help. Huge waste of time and very very frustrating. The scale just says setup. I spent a lot of money for an effin door stop, and it doesn't even do that very well. Do not purchase this product. BTW, they have no problem asking me to subscribe to their service. I am sure that wouldn't work either

I had to use or lose a wellness budget through work and this scale seemed like a good option. It's was $1xx. So a lot more than I would pay for a scale but it was "free". For a scale that cost as much as my groceries for a week it would not work. At all. Without first installing this app. As part of signing up for the app I had to list my height and weight... unfortunately I couldn't put an accurate weight because the scale did not work without the app set up...
1 person found this review helpful

I want to be able to decide and control when my device connects and what I share, not the horribly coded all that does not give me options. It's not necessary for you to have constant wifi access to the device. Love the device and how it works, you insistence on constant connection is horrible! Please fix this in the app and I will do another review!

Pretty nice app. Much better than the one I used to use and actually integrates with it. Nice to be able to output the reports to send to my doctor, but one huge neglect is that the reports don't include my notes put in for the abnormal entries. Have to add that to get that 5th star... if I can type it in, then export it to my report (at least give the user that choice).

The newest version seems like a step back. It is not laid out well and I have to make a few selections to get to 'all' daily metrics. Something that use to be front & center. I'm sure in their minds it was "all relavent info is now easy for you.. Blah, blah". I did not like the change. Sleep tracking is still big issue. Their trackers don't track sleep well & although they did add feature to edit, it only adds blank info. Also if the tracker didn't track sleep at all, nothing to edit & can't add

Edit: my gf wanted to use the scale, and it refused to give me any info since she didn't have a profile. But I couldn't add a new profile for the life of me... I hate this app so much, 1 stars... I could have sworn I remembered being able to actually choose what information was displayed in the app. I don't care about notifications for services I'm never going to buy. The UI feels ugly and disorganized, and the information does not seem to properly sync across my devices or other health apps.

Update: it's now been several weeks since I reported this error and when customer service couldn't solve it quickly, they just stopped replying. I would never buy another product of theirs, the customer service is appalling. As soon as I start the app and try to set up my account, I get an error entering my height and weight. I can't get any further so it's useless.

I agree with many other users. The app doesn't work well and when you go to the support forums it's all questions with no answers. It's a shame because I love the products but simple things don't work. Activity tracking doesn't update. Even though I am tracking all of the heart data with the correct hardware it says I'm only tracking 4 out of 7, etc. The products are great unfortunately the app is not.

This has made my weigh-ins easier. I love this scale for watching my trends. I'm not sure that the muscle & fat percents are super accurate as I paid for a more accurate one at my gym and my numbers were off by about 5%. But I do appreciate being able to watch those numbers from home. I LOVE that it shares the information automatically with the app on my phone.

This app sucks. Everything worked fine, and now my husband and I can't both see our information. The dashboard was removed for other features. There must have been an update, but we were not told about it or given an option not to accept it. Researching the problem it appears we need to sign out and sign back in every time?? I guess we own a really expensive paper weight.

Latest update: Now old sleep records show first so you have to poke around to find last night and the device is not updating or recording records. The app can take quite awhile to update stats. The update to the app is a problem. It works but your forgetting its purpose. The device is called sleep. Sleep info should be right up front like it was. Not health coach and you shouldn't have to click more steps to get to that long term info. Do you remember Jawbone? Don't do that.

Love that there is tracking for almost anything you could ask for on this app, including a lot of apps to connect and even open API, it's great! I haven't been able to connect Walgreens even though they claim to be compatible on their site, but not a serious issue. I would say the biggest thing that would make it 5 star worthy is menstrual tracking. I have to use Fitbit for that, it would be nice to pull that info and add to Withings instead though, since pregnancy tracking is already available.
1 person found this review helpful

Upate: The new version of the app is far inferior to earlier versions. I can no longer find my family's data, so I can't track my children's measurements. Sure, I can access their profile info and change their profile photo, but that's worthless. I will soon be in the market for a different product/app. I love the app and products. Can we please 🙏🏼 get a landscape option on the graphs📉 for the mobile app. Thank you.
1 person found this review helpful

This scale isn't even close to accurate, super frustrating for what it costs vs. what it does. My blood pressure reading has been correct once on it in 2 months which is whatever, no big deal. Where I get frustrated is the scale itself. How can it be accurate if it reads different things (more than 5 pounds difference in some cases) by just moving the location of the scale a few inches? I check to make sure that there is nothing under it and it's free of obstructions, still inaccurate.

The app works okay but can be a bit of a struggle to find things sometimes. I despise that when I open the app the first thing I see is if it thinks I'm gaining or losing weight. I wish I could turn that off, my weight fluctuates a lot and I'm used to that but seeing "gaining weight" even when I know it's just water is upsetting. I mitigate this by exporting to a different app and that charts my trending weight which is much more helpful.

Update 9.17.25 I'm no longer getting notifications for Google messages on my scanwatch. I have the application set for notifications in the app, along with the default "messages" option. I have done a unsync/resync of the device, and for about 3 weeks now it's just not showing those alerts. It's been frustrating because getting a text is one of the more important alerts I'm used to getting and now it's not working. It feels like this is a software issue of some kind.

App is flaky. Editing a workout saves and then reverts to the original data. Unfortunate, because the distance tracked by the scan watch is always incorrect. After noticing that my daily edits were reverting, I started uploading a photo of the treadmill screen after my run. Unfortunately, it's impossible to view photos uploaded to a workout after a day. You can see that there is a photo because there is a space for it, but the thumbnail doesn't appear and clicking on it shows a black screen.

Used to have 5 stars, but syncing has become clunky, needed to reconnect the device regularly to capture the last few weigh-ins. These should auto-sync over wifi as soon as the measurement is done, especially after pulling down to refresh. This also means the other apps I have linked do not get the data in a timely manner. Should have paid up for the Garmin scale.
1 person found this review helpful

I've had Body + scale for few years didn't have an issue. Now, after changing batteries, the app will not pair up, gives me generic "an error has occurred", no other details. Tried reinstalling the app multiple times. Their help page is of no use. Also, even without the app, the scale displays in kg even after I selected lbs and got a check mark but still goes back to kg.

horrible app, can't keep multiple users(2) straight. My wife's information is now mine and can't change it back. What a waste of time. DO NOT USE. It also changed my gender and can't find a way to change it back. UPDATE - I fixed it by deleting the app off my phone. My wife can use it to her delight. I simply get on the scale, look at my weight for 1-2 seconds and get off. I'd like to use the scale as an anchor, but it would be useless as the app.

The app is just alright for tracking weight, BMI, a plan for getting more healthy, and the ability to have numerous profiles on one scale, but the fact that there is no support for exporting data to Garmin is just a deal breaker for me. I shouldn't have to send data through 3 different apps just to get to Garmin. In 2022, we are figuratively minutes away from everything sharing data with everything else; both companies have been around long enough to make something work.

Used to be a useful and intuitive app. I could find all my data by just opening the app. Now I have to dig through menus and screens and still I don't see everything. Where did BMI go? Also the rest of the users of the scale are gone. Their profiles are still there but all their data are gone. Do your programmers actually try the app before releasing it? Do you give the app to everyday people to try before releasing it?? Do you take into account any feedback?? IF IT WORKS, DON'T TOUCH IT.

It's a decent app, but I'm very analytical and want more control over how to view my data such as changes in water weight a day. It's not straightforward on how to customize. For this to be a scale intricate and intelligent enough to measure body composition I find it interesting that they by default want to show me my BMI when it's long been established that the BMI is not an accurate assessment of someone's health. I don't like that it's present and can't seem to get rid of it.

i have edited this to a 1 star for the same reason. I've had this for over a year and the uninstall reinstall is needing to be done quite frequently as the device will frequently stop syncing to my app. This last time around, I couldn't get it to find my device so it's currently useless. Might as well buy a cheap scale and manually log my weight. I'm very disappointed. I like this app and scale, but it frequently disconnects and sometimes I have to uninstall and reinstall scale on the app.

takes some time to update activities and sleep stats. Seems to batch upload data at set intervals. For example, it will show that I only slept between midnight and 02:37 AM and then maybe by lunchtime, it will have updated my wake-up time to 07:37(which is when I really woke up). Also can occasionally interpret activities oddly: I've found "bicycling 4 minutes" logged when I was unloading groceries from the car then. Doesn't crash and eventually gets it all right though.

on nearly every page of the app they have an ad trying to get you to buy the subscription to Withings+. i already paid $500 for the scale, I'm not about to pay $100 a year for myself and again $100 for my wife to use it. also it could be better about displaying the body composition numbers. and it would be nice if i could remove components that are for their other products. i don't want your blood pressure cuff, or your watch or any of your other gadgets, i want an app for my $500 scale.

terrible app. very difficult to locate data. unable to see the status of the scale from the app. not sure if the scale is even syncing or not because the data is not displaying. when I first got the scale it worked fine, but if you have any substantial weight change, the scale will forget who you are and stop transmitting or displaying data. withing's answer is for you to factory reset everything. the scale part works fine but it's awfully expensive just for that.

App is straightforward and easy to use, but the Body+ scale consistently shows my body fat percentage to be about 5% higher than two other sources that I'm using to estimate body composition (reference pictures and an on-line body composition calculator that uses height, weight, age neck size and waist size). Regardless, watching weight and body composition *TRENDS* is useful to make sure my workout and diet programs are on the right track.

I am actually astounded by now trash the UI is compared to how advanced the hardware is. Concrete data is buried multiple screens deep; real numbers are not available in a simple list format for any metric other than total body weight. App gives misleading analysis, such as lost 1lb overnight, shows as gained 3lbs fat and lost 4lbs muscle (that's impossible, it's water).
